M-APPEARANCE-DRAWERS.Purpose: Reusable native IMGUI painting of individual widget surfaces, borders, rounded content images and outer shadows without child subtree compositing.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: BackgroundDrawer, BorderDrawer, ShadowDrawer and ImageDrawer operations for individual widget surfaces.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Shadow and BackgroundSize drawing parameters, CornerRadii normalization, BorderEdges and cached AppearanceMasks textures in Widgets/Drawers/.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Descendant clipping: geometry is published by M-WIDGET-GEOMETRY and queried by M-CLIP-SERVICE; native execution belongs to WidgetRenderer and concrete widget contexts.
Scope.SCP-OUT-002: Shared mutable Style object, generic offscreen group renderer or stencil backend.

Requirements.REQ-001: View orchestrates ShadowDrawer, BackgroundDrawer and BorderDrawer for its decorative surface. Image reuses ImageDrawer for its own content; specialized text and input widgets do not invoke decorative drawers.
Requirements.REQ-002: CornerRadii.Resolve honors explicit zero overrides and proportionally normalizes radii that exceed the surface bounds.
Requirements.REQ-003: Image placement supports Cover, Contain, Stretch and OriginalSize with configurable normalized background position; content images may be rounded within their own surface.
Requirements.REQ-004: AppearanceMasks caches a bounded number of native textures; FlexVerseRoot releases these shared masks on root destruction, not on widget unmount.
Requirements.REQ-005: Surface alpha is expressed through Colors/textures; no group opacity or already-rendered subtree processing is provided.

Inputs.IN-001: Surface Rect, colors/textures, radii and shadow description; BorderDrawer also accepts the owner Widget to read calculated Flexbox border widths through WidgetEngine.GetNode.

Outputs.OUT-001: Native IMGUI paint operations for the specified surface.

SideEffects.EFF-001: Draws through UnityEngine.GUI and lazily creates/caches Texture2D masks.
